<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Times New Roman',serif">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="ev-glow" cx="50%" cy="42%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f6d9ff" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#9a4dff" stop-opacity="0.4"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1a0a2e" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ev-gold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff3c4"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c99a2e"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="#120820"/>
  <circle cx="320" cy="150" r="150" fill="url(#ev-glow)">
    <animate attributeName="r" values="140;158;140" dur="3.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- the gem: circuit-cut, pulsing like a heartbeat -->
  <g transform="translate(320 150)">
    <polygon points="0,-46 40,-14 24,42 -24,42 -40,-14" fill="#e6c9ff" stroke="url(#ev-gold)" stroke-width="3">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.75;1;0.75" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </polygon>
    <g stroke="#c99aff" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.8">
      <path d="M0,-46 L0,42 M-40,-14 L40,-14 M-24,42 L24,-14"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#fff">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="4;9;4" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <text x="320" y="260" text-anchor="middle" font-size="42" letter-spacing="4" fill="url(#ev-gold)">Everlast™</text>
  <text x="320" y="290" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-style="italic" fill="#d9c2f0">"A diamond is forever. Now, so is she."</text>
  <text x="320" y="330" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#7a6088">BIOMETRIC PAIR-LOCK · NOT REMOVABLE WITHOUT BOTH CARDIAC SIGNATURES</text>
</svg>
description: Title card for the Everlast Augments commercial.
name: Everlast Augments — Logo
